$note: Hand session settings. The Hand dispatches workers, reads diffs and merges locally - all of it high-frequency and low-risk, so permission prompts are pure friction here. This file is tracked, so it is not the Hand's alone: it is in every worker worktree cut from this repository and in the review gate's checkout, and every key here reaches all of them.
$additionalDirectoriesNote: Deliberately empty, and it can stay that way. defaultMode below is bypassPermissions, and that already lets the Hand read, write, glob and run git against a repository on any drive - verified by test, not assumed. So annex works on a path anywhere without declaring its root here first, which is the point of registering a repository in place rather than cloning it. Fill this in only if you narrow defaultMode. Absolute paths, JSON-escaped backslashes: "D:\\code", "C:\\Users\\you\\projects".
$envNote: Every skill writes its commands as PowerShell. On macOS and Linux Claude Code's PowerShell tool is opt-in and this variable turns it on; on Windows it changes nothing for an ordinary account. Workers get the same key in the settings bin/ClaudeWorkspace.psm1 writes for them.

permissions.$denyNote: Edit(path), never Write(path). Claude Code matches file-editing tools against Edit rules only, and a Write rule here is not merely ignored - it prints 'Write(...) is not matched by file permission checks' at the top of EVERY response for the whole session. instructions.md is genuinely protected by the Edit rule below: a deny rule was verified to make the tool refuse with 'File is in a directory that is denied by your permission settings' and leave the file untouched.
